Name: Replacement Sensor Model Ground to Image Grid
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model Ground to Image Grid TRE (RSMGG) contains the ground point to image point correspondences that make up the RSM ground to image grid. The interpolated grid takes a ground position within the RSM ground domain into a corresponding image position within the RSM image domain. The coordinates of the resultant image position are with respect to the original full image. They are also within a specific section of the RSM image domain, as specified by the fields GGRSN and GGCSN. That is, a particular RSMGG TRE corresponds to a specific image section, as discussed in the RSMGI TRE format description.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping,re-sampling, or other such image-to-image transformations.The image identifier is left justified with trailing spaces.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

GGRSN.Name: Ground to image Grid Row Section Number
GGRSN.Description: This field contains the image row section number that the following ground-to-image grid applies to.

GGCSN.Name: Ground to image Grid Column Section Number
GGCSN.Description: This field contains the image row column number that the following ground-to-image grid applies to.

GGRFEP.Name: Ground to image Grid Row Fitting Error
GGRFEP.Description: This field contains the rms fit error estimate applicable to the row ground to image grid relative to the ground to image function of the original sensor model. The value of GGRFEP assumes that an RSM ground-to image polynomial is also employed, if available. When a ground to image polynomial is available, the ground to image grid represents corrections to the polynomial, and field GGRFEP represents the rms error of the combined polynomial and grid evaluation.

INTORD.Name: Ground to image Grid Interpolation Order
INTORD.Description: This field specifies the recommended interpolation order to be used in determining row and column image coordinates from the ground to image grid. The fitting error statistics provided in fields GGRFEP and GGCFEP above are based on assumed use of the recommended interpolation order. Field GGRFEP and GGCFEP should only be populated if field INTORD is populated.

NPLN.Name: Number of Grid Planes
NPLN.Description: This field contains the total number of grid planes.

DELTAZ.Name: Delta Z Between Grid Planes
DELTAZ.Description: This field contains the constant delta Z betweeen grid planes.

DELTAX.Name: Delta X Between Grid Points
DELTAX.Description: This field contains the constant delta X between points in a grid plane. This value is the same for all grid planes.

DELTAY.Name: Delta Y Between Grid Points
DELTAY.Description: This field contains the constant delta Y between points in a grid plane. This value is the same for all grid planes.

ZPLN1.Name: Z Value of Plane 1
ZPLN1.Description: This field contains the constant z value of the first plane. All other planes have greater z values. Within a given grid plane, all points have a common Z coordinate value.

XIPLN1.Name: X Value of Initial Point in Plane 1
XIPLN1.Description: This field contains the value of the x coordinate of the first grid point in the first grid plane.

YIPLN1.Name: Y Value of Initial Point in Plane 1
YIPLN1.Description: This field contains the constant z value of the first plane. All other planes have greater z values. Within a given grid plane, all points have a common Z coordinate value.

REFROW.Name: Reference Row Coordinate Value
REFROW.Description: This field contains the reference image row coordinate value across all grid points across all grid planes. This value is within the RSM image domain and with respect to the original full image.

REFCOL.Name: Reference Column Coordinate Value
REFCOL.Description: This field contains the reference image column coordinate value across all grid points across all grid planes. This value is within the RSM image domain and with respect to the original full image.

TNUMRD.Name: Total Number of Image Row Coordinate Digits
TNUMRD.Description: The value of this field specifies the total number of digits used in field RCOORD to specify the image row coordinate value relative to the value of REFROW.

TNUMCD.Name: Total Number of Image Column Coordinate Digits
TNUMCD.Description: The value of this field specifies the total number of digits used in field CCOORD to specify the image column coordinate value relative to the value of REFCOL.

FNUMRD.Name: Number of Image Row Coordinate Fractional Digits
FNUMRD.Description: The value of this field specifies the number of fractional digits used in field RCOORD to specify the image row coordinate value relative to the alue of REFROW.

FNUMCD.Name: Number of Image Column Coordinate Fractional Digits
FNUMCD.Description: The value of this field specifies the number of fractional digits used in field CCOORD to specify the image row coordinate value relative to the value of REFCOL.

IXO.Name: Initial Grid Points X Offset
IXO.Description: This field contains the offset of this grid plane initial grid point x coordinate value relative to the first grid plane initial grid point x coordinate value, expressed as a signed integer multiple of delta x.

IYO.Name: Initial Grid Points Y Offset
IYO.Description: This field contains the offset of this grid plane initial grid point y coordinate value relative to the first grid plane initial grid point y coordinate value, expressed as a signed integer multiple of delta y.

NXPTS.Name: Number of Grid Points in the X Direction
NXPTS.Description: This field contains the total number of grid points in the x direction in this grid plane. For this grid plane, the x coordinate of each grid point is equal to the initial grid point x coordinate plus a nonnegative multiple of delta x.

NYPTS.Name: Number of Grid Points in the Y Direction
NYPTS.Description: This field contains the total number of grid points in the y direction in this grid plane. For this grid plane, the y coordinate of each grid point is equal to the initial grid point y coordinate plus a nonnegative multiple of delta y.

RCOORD.Name: Grid Point Row Coordinate
RCOORD.Description: This field contains the value of the image row coordinate for the current grid point, expressed as a non negative offset from field REFROW. Grid points are stored in matrix row major order. The first matrix element corresponds to the initial grid point of this grid. A matrix row corresponds to a constant x coordinate value. A matrix column corresponds to a constant y coordinate value.

CCOORD.Name: Grid Point Column Coordinate
CCOORD.Description: This field contains the value of the image column coordinate for the current grid point, expressed as a non negative offset from field REFCOL. Grid points are stored in matrix row major order. The first matrix element corresponds to the initial grid point of this grid.  A matrix row corresponds to a constant x coordinate value. A matrix column corresponds to a constant y coordinate value.
